Method of Attack: Exploits known remote code execution vulnerabilities to compromise routers and IoT devices
Launches large-scale DDoS attacks including reflective attacks targeting Valve Source engine game servers
Searches for and deactivates competing botnet code to maintain control of compromised devices
Impacted Systems: Servers running Valve Source engine (game servers)
Attack Vector: Remote code execution vulnerabilities (CVE-2017-18368, CVE-2017-17215, CVE-2014-8361)
Command and control (C2) server commands to initiate DoS attacks
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of exploits for CVE-2017-18368, CVE-2017-17215, CVE-2014-8361
Reflective DoS attack traffic targeting Valve Source engine servers
Binary names and keywords associated with competing botnets (JenX, Hakai, Miori, Satori, Mirai)
